item.text: *Chlorophytum laxum* (Pongol Sword) is a flowering plant in the genus *Chlorophytum*. It is widespread across tropical Africa, Asia, and Australia and is also known as Bichetii grass, Siam lily, false lily turf, and wheat plant. [Source: s1:p2]
